title.narrative: Strengthening Health Systems and Communities through Government-Civil Society Partnerships - Mozambique (01-Mar-2024-31-Dec-2026)

description.narrative: Mozambique, RSSH, Ministry of Health of Mozambique (MISAU)This program has the following goals: Building a stronger Primary Health Care service. Strengthen the Health Sector's capacity to respond to emergencies subsequent to natural disasters and conflicts that result in the destruction of health infrastructure and massive mobilization of the population. The objectives of this program are: Improve system readiness for CHW. Improve availabilty of tracer health products for the three diseases - HIV, TB, malaria (as applicable) at facility level. Improve national medical products regulatory system maturity

Percentage of facilities providing patient-centered quality of care

Procurement administrative lead time (PALT): Percentage of planned procurements for products that account for 75% of the non-PPM annual health products budget with time intervals within the limits of PR procurement rules and regulations
Percentage of molecular diagnostic analyzers achieving at least 85% functionality (ability to test samples) during the reporting period
Percentage of health service delivery sites with a community-led monitoring mechanism in place
LMIS Reporting Rate - Percentage of all health facilities that are required to report that submit an LMIS report to central authority
